variants.zh: 你怎么还没回我
variants.en: You still haven't gotten back to me.

variants.zh: 有空回我一下呀
variants.en: Would you mind getting back to me when you get a chance?

variants.zh: 烦请确认是否已收到并审阅此前邮件
variants.en: Could you kindly confirm whether you've had a chance to review my previous email?

variants.zh: 谨再次跟进我上一封邮件，以免它不幸被淹没在收件箱里
variants.en: Just following up on my last email, in case it got buried in your inbox.

variants.zh: 文件还没发我
variants.en: You still haven't sent me the file.

variants.zh: 文件方便的时候发我一下
variants.en: Could you send the file over when you have a moment?

variants.zh: 烦请提供相关文件以供存档
variants.en: Please forward the relevant documents at your earliest convenience.

variants.zh: 为便于我持续推进，烦请惠赐此前所提及之文件
variants.en: To help me keep things moving, please don't forget the file you mentioned.

variants.zh: 钱还没到
variants.en: The payment hasn't come through yet.

variants.zh: 麻烦帮忙看下付款进度哈
variants.en: Could you check on the payment status for me?

variants.zh: 烦请确认款项是否已安排支付
variants.en: Could you please confirm whether the payment has been scheduled?

variants.zh: 发票早已寄出，想必付款已在流程中，烦请告知最新进展
variants.en: The invoice went out a while ago, so I assume payment is in progress — a brief update would be appreciated.

variants.zh: 你进度到哪了
variants.en: Where are you with this?

variants.zh: 想问问现在到哪一步了
variants.en: Just wondering where things stand?

variants.zh: 烦请同步当前进展及预计完成时间
variants.en: Please share a status update along with your estimated completion date.

variants.zh: 只想确认一下这个项目是否仍在推进之中
variants.en: Just want to confirm the project is still moving forward.

variants.zh: 你没收到吗，我再发一遍
variants.en: You didn't get it? I'll send it again.

variants.zh: 我这边显示已发送，要不我重发一下
variants.en: It shows as sent on my end — let me resend it just in case.

variants.zh: 如有必要，烦请告知，我将重新发送该邮件
variants.en: Please let me know if needed and I will resend the email.

variants.zh: 既然原邮件似乎未曾送达，现将全文再次附上，以供参考
variants.en: Since the original appears not to have arrived, I've reattached it below for your reference.

variants.zh: 你到底收到没有
variants.en: Did you actually get it or not?

variants.zh: 收到的话跟我说一声哈
variants.en: Let me know once you've got it.

variants.zh: 烦请确认是否已收悉
variants.en: Kindly confirm receipt.

variants.zh: 烦请惠予确认，以便我这边闭环
variants.en: A brief confirmation would allow me to close the loop on my end.

variants.zh: 什么时候要
variants.en: When do you need it?

variants.zh: 想问下最晚什么时候要呀
variants.en: What's the latest you'd need it?

variants.zh: 烦请告知截止时间，以便我安排
variants.en: Could you please advise on the deadline so I can plan accordingly?

variants.zh: 如能告知时间线，我这边会更好地配合您
variants.en: If you could share the timeline, I'd be in a much better position to accommodate you.

variants.zh: 我又来催了
variants.en: Here I am, nagging again.

variants.zh: 再提醒一下哈
variants.en: Just a gentle reminder.

variants.zh: 顺此再次提醒，烦请留意相关截止时间
variants.en: As a follow-up reminder, please note the applicable deadline.

variants.zh: 眼见截止日临近，谨此再次提请关注
variants.en: With the deadline approaching, I wanted to flag this once more.

intent: 对方说过晚点回后的追问

variants.zh: 你说的稍后到底是多会儿
variants.en: So when exactly is "later"?

variants.zh: 之前说稍后回我，有消息了吗
variants.en: Any update since you mentioned you'd get back to me?

variants.zh: 就此前您表示将另行答复之事项，烦请赐复
variants.en: Following up on the matter you said you would revisit.

variants.zh: 一直记挂着您说稍后的那次回复，想确认是否已有下文
variants.en: I've been holding onto that "later" you mentioned — wondering if it has taken shape.

variants.zh: 纪要呢
variants.en: Where are the minutes?

variants.zh: 麻烦把今天的会议纪要发一下哈
variants.en: Could you send over today's meeting notes?

variants.zh: 烦请提供本次会议纪要及待办事项
variants.en: Please circulate the minutes and action items from our meeting.

variants.zh: 为便于各方对齐，烦请分享会上所记之事
variants.en: To make sure everyone stays aligned, could you share what was captured in the meeting?

variants.zh: 材料还缺东西
variants.en: The materials are still missing something.

variants.zh: 材料还差一点，麻烦补一下哈
variants.en: The materials are almost there — could you fill in the gap?

variants.zh: 烦请补齐所缺材料，以便流程推进
variants.en: Please submit the outstanding materials so we can proceed.

variants.zh: 为免审核环节反复往返，烦请一次补齐所缺材料
variants.en: To spare us a few more rounds, please send the missing materials in one go.

variants.zh: 你还没签
variants.en: You still haven't signed it.

variants.zh: 方便的时候签一下哈
variants.en: Whenever you're free, could you sign it?

variants.zh: 烦请签署并回传该文件
variants.en: Please sign and return the document.

variants.zh: 文件已在您处停留数日，烦请安排签署
variants.en: The document has been sitting with you for a few days — your signature would be appreciated.

variants.zh: 还没批
variants.en: It still hasn't been approved.

variants.zh: 帮忙点一下审批哈
variants.en: Could you go ahead and approve it?

variants.zh: 烦请审核批准，以便进入下一阶段
variants.en: Please review and approve so we can move to the next stage.

variants.zh: 流程目前停在您这一步，烦请拨冗审批
variants.en: The process is currently sitting with you — please review at your convenience.

variants.zh: 反馈呢
variants.en: Where's the feedback?

variants.zh: 有什么想法随时跟我说哈
variants.en: Let me know your thoughts whenever.

variants.zh: 烦请提供反馈意见，以供后续修改
variants.en: Please share your feedback so I can incorporate it.

variants.zh: 若无进一步意见，我将视为已获认可并继续推进
variants.en: Absent further comments, I'll take it as approved and proceed.

variants.zh: 发票还没开
variants.en: The invoice still hasn't been issued.

variants.zh: 发票麻烦开一下哈
variants.en: Could you get the invoice issued?

variants.zh: 烦请开具发票，以便安排付款
variants.en: Please issue the invoice so payment can be arranged.

variants.zh: 款在等票，票一到即可安排
variants.en: The payment is waiting on the invoice — once it lands, I can move it right through.

variants.zh: 价格还没给我
variants.en: I still don't have your price.

variants.zh: 报价方便的时候发我哈
variants.en: Could you send the quote over when you can?

variants.zh: 烦请提供报价单，以便内部评估
variants.en: Please provide a quotation for our internal review.

variants.zh: 预算会议就在前头，缺您这份报价我很难推进
variants.en: My budget meeting is coming up — hard to move it forward without your quote.

variants.zh: 合同还没签回来
variants.en: The contract hasn't come back signed.

variants.zh: 合同那边有进展了吗
variants.en: Any progress on the contract?

variants.zh: 烦请确认合同签署状态
variants.en: Please confirm the status of the contract signing.

variants.zh: 合同已在流转中，烦请告知是否还有需要我配合之处
variants.en: The contract is in circulation — let me know if anything on my side is still needed.

variants.zh: 到底什么时候开始
variants.en: So when does this actually start?

variants.zh: 排期定了吗
variants.en: Has the schedule been set?

variants.zh: 烦请告知排期安排，以便协调资源
variants.en: Please advise on the schedule so resources can be coordinated.

variants.zh: 资源这边一直在待命，烦请尽早明确档期
variants.en: My team has been standing by — an early confirmation of the schedule would help.

variants.zh: 你倒是确认一下
variants.en: Just confirm it already.

variants.zh: 麻烦确认一下哈
variants.en: Could you confirm for me?

variants.zh: 烦请书面确认以上内容
variants.en: Please confirm the above in writing.

variants.zh: 若未收到异议，我将按此执行
variants.en: If I don't hear otherwise, I'll proceed on this basis.

variants.zh: 这事得催一下了
variants.en: Time to push on this.

variants.zh: 帮忙盯着点呗
variants.en: Could you keep an eye on this for me?

variants.zh: 烦请协助推进该事项
variants.en: Please help move this forward.

variants.zh: 鉴于时间已相当紧张，烦请优先处理
variants.en: Given how tight things are, I'd appreciate this being prioritized.

variants.zh: 还要多久
variants.en: How much longer?

variants.zh: 大概还要多久呀
variants.en: Roughly how much longer do you think?

variants.zh: 烦请提供预计完成时间
variants.en: Please provide an estimated completion date.

variants.zh: 如能给出一个大致时间，我这边也好向上交代
variants.en: A rough date would help me manage expectations on my side.

variants.zh: 对方还没给
variants.en: They still haven't sent it.

variants.zh: 对方那边有消息了吗
variants.en: Any word from them?

variants.zh: 烦请协助催促对方提供所需材料
variants.en: Please help follow up with them for the required materials.

variants.zh: 此事目前卡在对方一侧，烦请协助推动
variants.en: This is currently stuck on the other side — some help pushing would go a long way.

variants.zh: 别忘了开会
variants.en: Don't forget the meeting.

variants.zh: 提醒一下，等会儿有会哈
variants.en: Quick reminder about the meeting.

variants.zh: 谨此提醒今日会议安排，烦请准时出席
variants.en: A reminder of today's meeting — timely attendance is appreciated.

variants.zh: 会议上会用到您此前提及的那份资料，麻烦备好
variants.en: We'll be needing the document you mentioned — please have it on hand.

intent: 过了截止时间温和问责

variants.zh: 早就过截止时间了
variants.en: It's way past the deadline.

variants.zh: 好像已经过时间了，那边情况怎么样
variants.en: Looks like we're past the deadline — what's the situation?

variants.zh: 该事项已超出约定时间，烦请说明情况
variants.en: This item has exceeded the agreed deadline; please advise.

variants.zh: 原定时间已过，不知是否需要重新安排计划
variants.en: The original date has come and gone — perhaps the plan needs revisiting.

variants.zh: 周报呢
variants.en: Where's the weekly report?

variants.zh: 周报方便发一下哈
variants.en: Could you send the weekly update?

variants.zh: 烦请按约定提交周报
variants.en: Please submit the weekly report as agreed.

variants.zh: 顺带提醒，周报是每周固定项，不是可选项
variants.en: Just a reminder that the weekly report is a standing item, not an optional one.

variants.zh: 钱还没退
variants.en: The refund still hasn't come through.

variants.zh: 想问下退款进度哈
variants.en: Any update on the refund?

variants.zh: 烦请告知退款处理进展
variants.en: Please advise on the status of the refund.

variants.zh: 退款申请已提交有一阵了，烦请协助推动
variants.en: The refund request has been sitting for a while — some help moving it along would be great.

variants.zh: 你有空吗
variants.en: Are you free or not?

variants.zh: 最近哪天有空呀
variants.en: Which day works for you?

variants.zh: 烦请告知您方便的时间段
variants.en: Please let me know a time that works for you.

variants.zh: 我这边时间比较灵活，以您为准就好
variants.en: My calendar is flexible — I'll work around yours.

variants.zh: 帮我介绍一下
variants.en: Introduce me to them.

variants.zh: 能帮我引荐一下吗
variants.en: Would you mind introducing me?

variants.zh: 烦请代为引荐，不胜感激
variants.en: I'd be grateful if you could make an introduction.

variants.zh: 如果方便，可否帮忙牵个线？相信对双方都值得
variants.en: If it's not too much trouble, a quick intro could be worthwhile for both sides.

variants.zh: 你到底来不来
variants.en: Are you coming or not?

variants.zh: 来不来跟我说一声哈
variants.en: Let me know if you can make it.

variants.zh: 烦请确认是否出席，以便安排
variants.en: Please confirm your attendance so I can plan accordingly.

variants.zh: 座位和材料都按人数备好了，烦请尽早回复
variants.en: Seats and materials are set by headcount — an early reply would help.

variants.zh: 想请您看一下
variants.en: Could you take a look?

variants.zh: 想请您抽空看一下哈
variants.en: Would you have a moment to take a look?

variants.zh: 烦请您拨冗审阅并给予指示
variants.en: I'd appreciate your review and guidance at your convenience.

variants.zh: 深知您日程繁忙，谨附上摘要以便快速过目
variants.en: I know your schedule is full — a summary is attached so it's a quick read.

variants.zh: 我不想帮
variants.en: I don't want to help.

variants.zh: 这次可能帮不上哈
variants.en: I probably can't help with this one.

variants.zh: 抱歉，此事恕难协助
variants.en: Unfortunately, I'm unable to assist with this.

variants.zh: 相信您能理解，我这边资源的优先级已经排满了
variants.en: I'm sure you'll understand — my priorities are fully allocated at the moment.

variants.zh: 我不想加班
variants.en: I'm not working overtime.

variants.zh: 今天可能加不了班哈
variants.en: I can't stay late today, sorry.

variants.zh: 今日无法额外加班，烦请另行安排
variants.en: I'm unable to work additional hours today; please plan accordingly.

variants.zh: 长期加班的可持续性问题，值得我们一起看一看
variants.en: The sustainability of ongoing overtime might be worth a conversation.

variants.zh: 我没钱借你
variants.en: I don't have money to lend you.

variants.zh: 最近手头也紧，帮不上了
variants.en: I'm stretched thin myself right now, so I can't help.

variants.zh: 很抱歉，此事我恐怕无法应允
variants.en: I'm afraid I'm not in a position to accommodate this.

variants.zh: 朋友之间谈钱容易伤感情，我宁愿不冒这个险
variants.en: Money tends to complicate friendships — I'd rather not risk ours.

variants.zh: 你自己做
variants.en: Do it yourself.

variants.zh: 这次还是你自己来吧，我可以教你怎么弄
variants.en: This one's better done by you — I'm happy to show you how.

variants.zh: 基于职责划分，此事需由您方完成
variants.en: Given the division of responsibilities, this needs to be handled on your side.

variants.zh: 我把方法写下来了，你自己做一遍比我替你做还快
variants.en: I've written down the method — doing it once yourself will be faster than me doing it for you.

variants.zh: 我不去
variants.en: I'm not going.

variants.zh: 这次就不去啦，下次约
variants.en: I'll sit this one out — next time.

variants.zh: 感谢邀请，惜此次恐难出席
variants.en: Thank you for the invitation; unfortunately I won't be able to attend.

variants.zh: 心意收到了，日程实在腾不出，改天我做东
variants.en: I appreciate the thought — my schedule just won't budge. My treat next time.

variants.zh: 这个会我不想开
variants.en: I don't want this meeting.

variants.zh: 这个会我可能参加不了，有别的办法吗
variants.en: I might not be able to make this — is there another way?

variants.zh: 该时段已有安排，烦请提供会议记录
variants.en: I have a conflict at that time; please share the notes instead.

variants.zh: 若无必须我出席的议题，可否先同步材料？
variants.en: Unless my presence is required, could we start with the materials?

variants.zh: 不需要
variants.en: Not interested.

variants.zh: 谢谢，暂时用不上哈
variants.en: Thanks, but I don't need it right now.

variants.zh: 感谢推荐，暂无相关需求
variants.en: Thank you; I have no current need for this.

variants.zh: 我留着您的联系方式，有需要的时候会主动找您
variants.en: I'll keep your contact — I'll reach out if the need arises.

variants.zh: 又加需求？
variants.en: Adding more again?

variants.zh: 这个可以，但得算进下一期哈
variants.en: That's doable, but it would need to go into the next cycle.

variants.zh: 该项超出既定范围，需另行走变更流程
variants.en: This falls outside the agreed scope and would require a change request.

variants.zh: 范围一旦松动，时间和质量就得有一样让步，您倾向哪个？
variants.en: Once scope loosens, either time or quality has to give — which would you prefer?

variants.zh: 不降价
variants.en: I'm not lowering the price.

variants.zh: 价格这边确实没什么空间了
variants.en: There really isn't any room on the price.

variants.zh: 该报价已是我们的最优方案
variants.en: The quotation reflects our best possible terms.

variants.zh: 降价的另一面通常是降低标准，我猜您更在意后者
variants.en: Lowering the price usually means lowering the standard — I assume you'd rather not.

variants.zh: 不能再拖了
variants.en: No more extensions.

variants.zh: 时间这边实在挪不动了
variants.en: I really can't move the timeline.

variants.zh: 原定时间无法顺延，烦请按计划执行
variants.en: The agreed timeline cannot be extended; please proceed as planned.

variants.zh: 每往后一天，成本都落在后面的人身上
variants.en: Every extra day comes out of someone else's pocket.

variants.zh: 这不是我的锅
variants.en: That's not on me.

variants.zh: 这事好像不全在我这边哈
variants.en: I don't think this one's entirely on me.

variants.zh: 该环节的交接记录，我可以一并提供
variants.en: I can share the handover records for that step.

variants.zh: 责任归属讲清楚了，事情才好往前走
variants.en: Once ownership is clear, the work can actually move forward.

variants.zh: 不给
variants.en: No.

variants.zh: 密码这种东西我不太方便给哈
variants.en: I'm not comfortable sharing passwords.

variants.zh: 出于安全规范，账号恕不外借
variants.en: Per security policy, account credentials cannot be shared.

variants.zh: 借号一旦出问题，担责的是我，所以我只能守住这条线
variants.en: If anything goes wrong with the account, it lands on me — so I have to hold this line.

variants.zh: 我不去
variants.en: I'm not transferring.

variants.zh: 这个岗位我暂时没打算哈
variants.en: That role isn't in my plans right now.

variants.zh: 感谢考虑，惜与个人规划不符
variants.en: Thank you for considering me; this doesn't align with my current plans.

variants.zh: 我更想在现在这条线上做出成绩，希望理解
variants.en: I'd rather build something concrete where I am — I hope that's understandable.

variants.zh: 别打电话
variants.en: Don't call me.

variants.zh: 电话不太方便，文字说吧
variants.en: A call's not convenient — text works better.

variants.zh: 目前不便通话，烦请以书面形式沟通
variants.en: I'm unavailable for a call; please communicate in writing.

variants.zh: 打字能留下记录，对我们双方都省事
variants.en: Written messages leave a record — easier for both of us.

variants.zh: 不加
variants.en: I'm not adding you.

variants.zh: 我这边不太加微信哈
variants.en: I don't really add people on WeChat.

variants.zh: 后续沟通请走官方渠道
variants.en: Please use the official channel going forward.

variants.zh: 保持流程内沟通，对双方都是保护
variants.en: Keeping things in-channel protects us both.

variants.zh: 不聊了
variants.en: I'm done chatting.

variants.zh: 我先忙别的去啦
variants.en: I'll go take care of something else.

variants.zh: 此事如无其他事项，先告一段落
variants.en: If there's nothing further, let's leave it here.

variants.zh: 时间留给更重要的事吧
variants.en: I'll leave your time to something more important.

variants.zh: 会就开到这
variants.en: Let's end the meeting here.

variants.zh: 要不我们先到这儿哈
variants.en: Shall we wrap up here?

variants.zh: 如无其他议题，本次会议到此结束
variants.en: If there are no other items, we'll close the meeting here.

variants.zh: 会议精简一点，大家的时间都更值钱
variants.en: Keeping meetings lean makes everyone's time worth more.

variants.zh: 别回了
variants.en: Don't reply.

variants.zh: 这条不用回啦
variants.en: No need to reply to this one.

variants.zh: 本邮件无需回复
variants.en: No response is required to this email.

variants.zh: 就此收尾，不再往复，节省彼此时间
variants.en: Let's close the thread here and save us both the back-and-forth.

variants.zh: 下班别找我
variants.en: Don't contact me after hours.

variants.en: I'd rather ask than guess and then redo it.

variants.zh: 你得出面
variants.en: You need to step in.

variants.zh: 这事能不能请您帮着说一句哈
variants.en: Could you lend a word on this?

variants.zh: 烦请就此事给予必要支持
variants.en: I'd appreciate your necessary support on this matter.

variants.zh: 我该做的都做了，剩下的部分只有您的分量推得动
variants.en: I've done what I can — the rest needs your weight behind it.

variants.zh: 我要涨工资
variants.en: I want a raise.

variants.zh: 想聊聊薪资这块哈
variants.en: Could we talk about compensation?

variants.zh: 希望就薪酬水平进行一次正式沟通
variants.en: I'd like to discuss my compensation formally.

variants.zh: 我这一年做了什么您看得到，我想聊聊它对应的价值
variants.en: You've seen what I did this year — I'd like to discuss what it's worth.

variants.zh: 帮我写封推荐信
variants.en: Write me a recommendation letter.

variants.zh: 方便的话能帮我写封推荐信吗
variants.en: Would you be able to write me a recommendation?

variants.zh: 烦请惠赐推荐信，所需材料我可一并准备
variants.en: I'd be grateful for a letter of recommendation; I'll prepare any materials needed.

variants.zh: 我会把材料备齐，尽量不占用您太多时间
variants.en: I'll have everything ready so it takes as little of your time as possible.

variants.zh: 我不干了
variants.en: I quit.

variants.zh: 想跟您聊一下我的离职安排
variants.en: I'd like to talk about my departure.

variants.zh: 现正式提出辞呈，烦请告知后续流程
variants.en: I'm formally submitting my resignation; please advise on next steps.

variants.zh: 这段时间我从这儿学到不少，也希望能好聚好散
variants.en: I've learned a lot here — I'd like us to part well.

variants.zh: 行，我知道了
variants.en: Fine, I get it.

variants.zh: 你说得对，我改哈
variants.en: You're right — I'll fix it.

variants.zh: 感谢指正，我将据此调整
variants.en: Thank you for the correction; I'll adjust accordingly.

variants.zh: 这条我认，另外还有两条也想请您一并看看
variants.en: I'll take that — and I'd like your read on two others as well.

variants.zh: 我不同意
variants.en: I disagree.

variants.zh: 我这边有点不一样的想法哈
variants.en: I see it a bit differently.

variants.zh: 就该方案，我持保留意见，理由如下
variants.en: I have reservations about this proposal, for the following reasons.

variants.zh: 如果大家都没意见，就更该有人把风险讲清楚，我来当这个人
variants.en: If everyone agrees, someone should still name the risk — I'll be that person.

variants.zh: 你写错了
variants.en: You made an error here.

variants.zh: 这个地方好像有点小问题哈
variants.en: This part looks slightly off.

variants.zh: 该处数据存在偏差，烦请核对
variants.en: There's a discrepancy in this figure; please verify.

variants.zh: 帮您标出来了，改不改由您，但记录上我得留一句
variants.en: I've flagged it — your call whether to change it, but I'll note it for the record.

variants.zh: 我觉得应该这样
variants.en: I think it should be done this way.

variants.zh: 我有个小建议哈
variants.en: I have a small suggestion.

variants.zh: 谨提出以下建议，供参考
variants.en: I'd like to offer the following suggestions for consideration.

variants.zh: 我的建议可能不讨喜，但它比事后返工便宜
variants.en: My suggestion may not be welcome, but it's cheaper than redoing this later.

variants.zh: 你赶紧定
variants.en: Just decide already.

variants.zh: 这个得您拍板哈
variants.en: This one's your call.

variants.zh: 烦请就该事项作出决定，以便后续推进
variants.en: Please make a decision on this so we can proceed.

variants.zh: 我这边所有选项都摆好了，等的只是一个决定
variants.en: All the options are on the table — only a decision is outstanding.

variants.zh: 我不同意
variants.en: I don't agree.

variants.zh: 我可能想法不太一样哈
variants.en: I might see it differently.

variants.zh: 对此我持不同看法，理由如下
variants.en: I see this differently, and here's why.

variants.zh: 我完全理解这个方向的好处，只是担心它只在幻灯片上成立
variants.en: I fully see the appeal — I'm just worried it only works on the slide.

variants.zh: 你误会了
variants.en: You've got it wrong.

variants.zh: 可能我表达得不清楚哈
variants.en: I may not have said it clearly.

variants.zh: 谨此澄清：此前表述并非您所理解之意
variants.en: To clarify: my earlier wording did not mean what it was taken to mean.

variants.zh: 与其猜我在想什么，不如直接问我，答案不会咬人
variants.en: Rather than guess at my intent, just ask — the answer doesn't bite.

variants.zh: 这不是我的错
variants.en: That's not my fault.

variants.zh: 这事我这边好像没问题哈
variants.en: I don't think this came from my side.

variants.zh: 就该环节，我方可提供完整记录以供核对
variants.en: We can provide complete records for that step for verification.

variants.zh: 我接受被批评，但不接受被错误地批评，这是两件事
variants.en: I accept criticism — just not inaccurate criticism. Those are two things.

variants.zh: 你得写下来
variants.en: Put it in writing.

variants.zh: 方便的话发个文字确认哈
variants.en: Could you confirm that in writing?

variants.zh: 烦请以邮件形式确认上述内容
variants.en: Please confirm the above by email.

variants.zh: 口头说过的容易记不住，写下来的才算数
variants.en: Spoken things get forgotten; written ones count.

variants.zh: 得走流程
variants.en: It has to go through the process.

variants.zh: 这个还是得走一下流程哈
variants.en: This still needs to go through the process.

variants.zh: 该项需按既定流程办理
variants.en: This must be handled per the established process.

variants.zh: 我理解想快，但流程本来就是为慢的时候准备的
variants.en: I understand wanting speed — the process exists for when things go wrong.

variants.zh: 去不了
variants.en: Can't come.

variants.zh: 谢谢邀请，这次去不了哈
variants.en: Thanks for the invite — I can't make it this time.

variants.zh: 感谢盛情邀约，惜未能出席，深表遗憾
variants.en: Thank you for the kind invitation; I regret I'm unable to attend.

variants.zh: 被想起是件好事，这份心意我记着
variants.en: Being thought of is a good thing — I'll remember the gesture.

variants.zh: 不行
variants.en: No.

variants.zh: 谢谢你想到我，但这次真帮不上
variants.en: Thanks for thinking of me, but I can't this time.

variants.zh: 感谢您的信任，惜此次无法承接
variants.en: Thank you for your confidence; unfortunately I can't take this on.

variants.zh: 每次都能想到我，是我的荣幸；不能每次都答应，也是我的分寸
variants.en: Being remembered is an honor — saying no sometimes is part of my own line.

variants.zh: 交给你了
variants.en: It's yours now.

variants.zh: 后面就交给你啦
variants.en: I'll hand this over to you.

variants.zh: 现就相关工作作如下交接，烦请确认接收
variants.en: The following handover is provided; please confirm acceptance.

variants.zh: 我写得详细一点，省得以后还要打电话问我
variants.en: I'm writing it in detail so nobody has to call me later.

variants.zh: 你帮我看看
variants.en: Take a look at it.

variants.zh: 能不能帮我看一眼哈
variants.en: Could you take a quick look?

variants.zh: 烦请协助复核，重点为数据与结论
variants.en: Please review, with focus on the data and conclusions.

variants.zh: 我尽量不留错，但多一双眼睛总是值的
variants.en: I try not to leave errors — a second pair of eyes is always worth it.

variants.zh: 你得赔
variants.en: You need to compensate me.

variants.zh: 这事总得有个说法吧
variants.en: There should be some remedy for this.

variants.zh: 就该情况，我方提出补偿请求，细节如下
variants.en: We request compensation for this situation; details below.

variants.zh: 我不想把事情闹大，所以把条件直接写在这里
variants.en: I'd rather not escalate — so the terms are simply written below.

variants.zh: 你该道歉
variants.en: You should apologize.

variants.zh: 我觉得这儿欠一句道歉
variants.en: An apology seems due here.

variants.zh: 就该事项，我方期待正式致歉
variants.en: We expect a formal apology on this matter.

variants.zh: 我不需要您难受，只需要您承认一次
variants.en: I don't need you to suffer — just to acknowledge it once.

variants.zh: 我支持你
variants.en: I'm with you.

variants.zh: 我站你这边哈
variants.en: I'm on your side.

variants.zh: 我方对该方案表示支持
variants.en: We express our support for this proposal.

variants.zh: 意见我来提，票我还是投你，这两件事不冲突
variants.en: I'll raise my concerns and still vote with you — those aren't in conflict.

variants.zh: 我担心
variants.en: I'm worried.

variants.zh: 我有点担心这块哈
variants.en: I'm a bit worried about this part.

variants.zh: 就该方案的风险，谨提请注意
variants.en: I'd like to flag the risks in this proposal.

variants.zh: 我不想当那个扫兴的人，但比起扫兴，我更怕事后无话可说
variants.en: I'd rather not be the wet blanket — but silence afterward frightens me more.

variants.zh: 我们不合作了
variants.en: We're done working together.

variants.zh: 这次可能就到这儿吧
variants.en: I think this is where we part ways.

variants.zh: 经慎重考虑，我方决定终止本次合作
variants.en: After careful consideration, we've decided to end this collaboration.

variants.zh: 合作讲究彼此都值得，这一点我们大概都没做到
variants.en: A partnership needs to be worth it for both — I suspect we both fell short.
